why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Kody Clemens is slot #7 (4.416 expected team runs/game).
Slots #7, #6, #8, #3, #5, #4, #2, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #3 ranks 4 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.003 R/G.
Slot #7 yields 4.00 expected PA/game vs 4.42 at primary slot #3. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Power (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models -0.000 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
